name: basecamp-manager
description: Read and manage Basecamp cards from Claude Code, with a guard hook that blocks deletes and writes to anything that is not yours

allow_claim.title: Allow claiming unassigned cards
allow_claim.description: Let Claude assign an unassigned card to you (one write, only when you ask). Cards in protected columns can never be claimed.

allow_comments.title: Allow creating comments
allow_comments.description: Let Claude post comments on your cards. Comments can never be edited or removed.

allow_uploads.title: Allow uploading evidence
allow_uploads.description: Let Claude upload screenshots, recordings and PDFs to Basecamp so it can embed them in comments or descriptions of your cards. No other file type can be uploaded.

own_unassigned_edit_minutes.title: Edit window for your unassigned cards (minutes)
own_unassigned_edit_minutes.description: How long a card you created, still without assignees, stays editable. 0 means no time limit (it stays editable until it is assigned or reaches a protected column).

card_language.title: Language for card text
card_language.description: Language Claude uses when it writes card titles, steps and comments. 'auto' follows the language you write in.

use_workflow.title: Use the suggested card workflow
use_workflow.description: Follow the optional workflow conventions (a card per task, one-line steps, PR comment and move to review). Off by default.
